leech-lake-dam.geojson.caveats: Hand-built point; no USACE GIS service exists. USACE legacy Water Control site (mvp-wc.usace.army.mil) carries a banner that it will be retired in fall 2026 with a replacement under development — re-check the gauge link-out at publish time; the three gauge URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-11-21. Interpretive wording needs tribal guidance: the dams flooded Ojibwe land; 1985 settlement $3,390,288 for land taken (Carroll, Minnesota History, Spring 1990, MNHS). No interpretive text is included in the GeoJSON — factual fields only. The point marks the dam structure (GNIS); the USACE gauge station MissHW_Leech sits about 90 m south at approx. 47.24747, -94.22184. Live gauge link-out: https://www.mvp-wc.usace.army.mil/reports/MissHW_Leech.Report.shtml (data: .../data/MissHW_Leech.Data.shtml; headwaters summary: .../gages/web-gages-MississippiHeadwaters.shtml). USGS dam gauges 05206000 and 05206500 are discontinued; dam outflow is USACE-only.
leech-lake-dam.geojson.query: Hand-built point; no GIS service exists. Location from GNIS Dam-class entry / USGS 1:24K Federal Dam, MN quad (47.24829, -94.22191, NAD83); facts from USACE St. Paul District recreation page and Headwaters history article; MNopedia dams article as corroboration.
